content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial permits a formal appeal, while retroactive authorization is closed and peer-to-peer review is unavailable. Despite one similar claim paying after submit_clean, four unchanged submissions here have failed; a medical-necessity appeal supported by the strong documentation offers a distinct recovery path and paid 7 of 21 similar claims. The patient has no contractual share and no secondary coverage, so patient billing is inappropriate, and write-off is premature while an appeal remains available.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
